id.instruksi: Dengarkan di mana hewannya ditemukan. Pilih terumbu dangkal, laut dalam di luar palung, atau dasar palung.
id.t-1: Ikan kakatua menggigit karang untuk makan. Antar ke mana?
id.t-2: Kuda laut berpegangan pada karang dengan ekornya. Antar ke mana?
id.t-3: Belut laut bersembunyi di lubang karang yang terang. Antar ke mana?
id.t-4: Siput laut berwarna cerah merayap di antara karang. Antar ke mana?
id.t-5: Cumi vampir ditemukan jauh di bawah terumbu, di air gelap di luar palung. Antar ke mana?
id.t-6: Ikan kapak berperut bercahaya ditemukan di air gelap di luar palung. Antar ke mana?
id.t-7: Hiu goblin ditemukan berenang di lereng laut dalam, sebelum sampai ke palung. Antar ke mana?
id.t-8: Kutu laut raksasa ditemukan di dasar laut yang gelap, di luar palung. Antar ke mana?
id.t-9: Ikan siput palung hidup di tempat paling dalam di seluruh laut. Antar ke mana?
id.t-10: Hewan mirip udang berwarna pucat hidup di dasar palung. Antar ke mana?
id.t-11: Teripang bening hidup di lubang laut yang paling dalam. Antar ke mana?

en.judul: Take the Animal to Its Layer
en.instruksi: Listen to where the animal was found. Choose the shallow reef, the deep sea outside the trench, or the trench floor.
en.t-1: The parrotfish bites coral to eat. Where does it go?
en.t-2: The seahorse holds onto coral with its tail. Where does it go?
en.t-3: The moray eel hides in a hole in the bright coral. Where does it go?
en.t-4: A brightly coloured sea slug crawls among the coral. Where does it go?
en.t-5: The vampire squid was found far below the reef, in dark water outside the trench. Where does it go?
en.t-6: The hatchetfish with a glowing belly was found in dark water outside the trench. Where does it go?
en.t-7: A goblin shark was found swimming along a deep-sea slope before the trench. Where does it go?
en.t-8: A giant isopod was found on the dark seafloor outside the trench. Where does it go?
en.t-9: The trench snailfish lives in the deepest place in the whole ocean. Where does it go?
en.t-10: A pale shrimp-like animal lives on the trench floor. Where does it go?
en.t-11: A see-through sea cucumber lives in the deepest hole in the sea. Where does it go?

itemCount.keterangan: selalu 3 lapisan: terumbu, laut dalam, palung; hewan berbeda dari paket Rumah di Lapisan Laut
